content.what_it_is: A V35/0x24 text-form compiler interface artifact for etauv_solver_module, generated from etauv_solver_gpu.f90. It records the GPU eta/U/V estimator, CUDA and cuSPARSE tridiagonal solvers and periodic variants, x/y initialization and sweep kernels, transpose and post-solver kernels, hydrodynamic controls and device arrays, launch/timing/cuSPARSE state, and opaque compiler tables (lines 1-2450).
entities: etauv_solver_module compiler-interface artifact generated from etauv_solver_gpu.f90 (lines 1-2)
Dependencies on NVIDIA accelerator, CUDA runtime, cuTENSOR, GPU reduction/sort, cudafor_la, iso_c_binding, cuSPARSE, param, mod_cuda, and global modules (lines 4-17)
Grid, staging, dispersion, periodicity, eta limiting, depth/Froude, wavemaker, MPI-neighbor, and processor controls (lines 225-267)
Hydrodynamic device fields u_d, v_d, hu_d, hv_d, ubar_d, vbar_d, masks, depth, eta state, flux/source derivatives, and wavemaker mass (lines 280-337)
CUDA launch, transpose, timing/event, stream, cuSPARSE handle/buffer, and tridiagonal-solver state (lines 338-359)
Tridiagonal work vectors, boundary vectors, coefficient matrices, row buffers, and their compiler array descriptors (lines 629-929)
estimate_huv_gpu and huv_bar_kernel interfaces for staged H/U/V estimation and limiting (lines 930-995)
tridx_tridy_cuda, periodic_tridx_tridy_cuda, tridx_cusparse, tridy_cusparse, and periodic_tridy_cusparse orchestration interfaces (lines 936-955)
x/y tridiagonal initialization kernels, including cuSPARSE variants and periodic controls (lines 975-1055)
x/y forward-sweep, back-substitution, direct CUDA tridiagonal, transpose, and post-tridiagonal kernel interfaces (lines 1056-1218)
Opaque compiler attributes, expressions, cross-references, argument maps, and type records (lines 18-224, 360-628, 1219-2450)
unresolved: The V35/0x24 compiler module format and the meanings of its D/S/R/A/F/J/V/T/X/Z numeric records, flags, offsets, and bit masks are not defined within the artifact, so most numeric metadata cannot be decoded from the file alone (lines 1, 18-2450).
The timestamp 06/12/2026 does not state whether its date order is month/day or day/month (line 3).

The interface exposes n_suth and n_nrth alongside n_west and n_east, while separate device-boundary fields use n_bottom and n_top; the artifact does not establish whether the abbreviated spellings are intentional or misspellings (lines 259-284).
